shared_elements: rows of repeated short strokes or marks
long curved boat-like/hull-like arc with vertical strokes rising from it (in A, lower-left; in B, the boat)
justification: Both surfaces depict schematic profile animals and dense series of repeated short strokes, and each contains a long shallow arc from which many small vertical marks rise (a crewed hull in B, a hatched curved motif near the animal heads in A), which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise the content diverges sharply: A is dominated by a continuous field of large barbed zigzag bands attached to long-necked heads with dot-in-circle eyes, while B shows isolated, solid-painted figures — a single small quadruped, detached legs, and one boat — scattered on an open field.
